# M1-01 — Problem Statement & Business Need Analysis

## Labels
`docs`, `milestone-1`, `priority-high`

## Milestone
Milestone 1 — Engineering Foundation & Requirements Baseline

## Tasks
- [ ] Write a CivicConnect-specific problem analysis (do not rewrite the scenario verbatim)
- [ ] Identify the core operational/information-management problems the platform must solve
- [ ] Articulate the business need and intended stakeholder/business value
- [ ] Link the problem statement explicitly to stakeholder needs (cross-reference M1-02)
- [ ] Add the section into PED v1.0 with a stable section number
- [ ] Team review of the section before baseline sign-off

## Acceptance Criteria
- Problem statement is specific to CivicConnect's actual operating context, not a paraphrase of the brief.
- Business need is expressed in terms of value delivered, not just "build an app".
- Every stakeholder-value claim traces to an identified stakeholder in the Stakeholder Register.
- Section is integrated into PED v1.0, versioned, and reviewed by at least one other team member.
